phases.entry_check: Install additive tables and policy parser; old auth grammar and existing endpoints remain compatible. No enrollment. Desk tests policy fixtures and duplicate-token/id rejection without exposing values.
phases.rollback: Disable API, keep new tables; previous binary safe because no enforced jobs exist.

phases.entry_check: Centrally create shadow subject claims and P1 review assignments as §6 specifies. Subjects dual-write with warnings; review-role own lifecycles are receipt-required from claim under §2. Compare counts/identities/parent/coverage. Director still calls the subject/fleet bound O2 until Q12/P2.
phases.rollback: End any live canonical reviewer assignments through the server before stopping their transport; keep receipt fences for them. Subject shadow clients may return to O2; preserve records/projections, imports stay untrusted. No subject/fleet bound was claimed.

phases.phase: P2 host canary enforcement: server WRK_RECORDS_API=enforce, per-job activate record, client --records-mode=required
phases.entry_check: First desktop canary, then mac-dev, mac-work, rpi. Q12=a makes durable commits with synchronous_commit=on, desk backup/WAL restore drill, store-generation freeze fence and independently retained director receipts mandatory preconditions before P2. Activate only between rounds and after server, wrk, CLI, panewire/delegation, director gates and every quota consumer support receipts. Subject activation and canonical review-role enrollment are authoritative under §2; flags cannot downgrade either.
phases.rollback: Pause enrolled jobs. Run earlier O3-capable binary/read-only mode if necessary. Keep protected-task/receipt gates active; finish or end through recovered server. Do not roll back to a pre-O3 server while any enforced job is active.

phases.phase: P3 fleet default: central claim policy NEW_JOBS_RECORDS_REQUIRED=true
phases.entry_check: All new builder/worker subjects receive central claims and activation; review-role assignments follow Q13; imported in-flight jobs use conservative floor. Nonreceipt completions and unknown jobs are refused by director/quota consumers.
phases.rollback: Stop new enrollment; P2 rollback for active jobs. Legacy-only jobs remain explicitly marked O2.
